ABOUT AJ TORO

We understand the work behind the workforce.

AJ TORO WELDINGS brings a practical, trade-informed perspective to sourcing welding and fabrication personnel. Our network includes tradespeople with backgrounds in heavy steel, industrial workshops, piping and major project environments.

We focus on understanding what each site actually needs: the right trade, relevant experience, clear mobilisation expectations and dependable communication.

Our founder’s hands-on experience includes working in Australian industrial environments and participating in structural steel and infrastructure work. We believe reliability, consistency and respect for site requirements matter as much as a résumé.

WHAT WE SUPPORT

Trade capability for demanding sites.

From workshop fabrication to site-based piping and structural steel work, talk to us about the skills your project requires.

01 / WELDING

Welders

MIG, FCAW, SMAW and GTAW backgrounds across workshop and site-based work, matched to individual project requirements.

02 / FABRICATION

Boilermakers

03 / PIPING

Pipe Fitters

Pipe fabrication, installation and project exposure in industrial facilities, LNG and plant environments.

A CREW WITH SHARED HISTORY

20 years of trust. Experience working together.

Our three core tradespeople have known one another for more than 20 years and have worked together on power station projects. Their longstanding relationship and shared site experience provide a foundation for communication, teamwork and coordinated mobilisation when project requirements align.

Their 20-year relationship does not imply 20 years of continuous work together. Crew composition and availability are confirmed for each project.
